label: EZECOM
subject: Abuse investigation request: 113.130.126.113 — 15 Nov 2026, 17:00–18:00 UTC
body:
Hello EZECOM Incident Response Team,

I operate MOONDA at https://moonda.us. Please investigate suspected automated abuse from 113.130.126.113 against our paid AI endpoint, https://moonda.us/api/ai.

The incident occurred on 16 November 2026, 00:00–01:00 Cambodia time (15 November 2026, 17:00–18:00 UTC), with most activity around 00:06–00:14 Cambodia time.

Cloudflare's incident view shows 1,079 requests to this endpoint, with 1,074 attributed to that source IP. User-agent totals include 980 Python/3.14 aiohttp/3.14.5 requests and 88 curl/8.22.0 requests. A sampled record at 00:14:00 Cambodia time confirms an aiohttp POST from that IP. I have attached a summary of the relevant evidence.

Separately, DeepSeek's per-key export records 353 Pro calls and CNY37.4647827 charged during the hour. These billing records cannot be matched one-to-one to Cloudflare requests. The Cloudflare analytics may be sampled.

Please investigate this network activity and preserve any relevant address-assignment and connection records still available for the stated period. Please let me know what further technical evidence or formal process you require. I do not have the source port in the recovered Cloudflare record.

The evidence does not identify the individual operating this connection. It could involve a shared network, proxy or compromised device. I am requesting an internal investigation, not public disclosure of subscriber information, and am not accusing a named person or group.

A replacement API key is active; the old key was revoked. Server-side usage limits are now deployed.

Please acknowledge receipt and provide a case reference.

Zhihao Wu
MOONDA operator

label: DeepSeek
subject: MOONDA API abuse: request for refund or account credit of CNY37.46
body:
Hello DeepSeek API Support,

Please investigate suspected automated abuse of my MOONDA API proxy and consider refunding CNY37.46 or granting an equivalent account credit for the affected usage.

Account email: zhihaowu003@gmail.com
Affected API key label: moonda (old key revoked; replacement active)
Model: deepseek-v4-pro
Incident window: 16 November 2026, 00:00–01:00 Cambodia time (15 November 2026, 17:00–18:00 UTC)

Your per-key export records 353 requests and CNY37.4647827 charged during that hour:
- 13,140,608 cached input tokens
- 266,761 uncached input tokens
- 2,540,242 output tokens
- 15,947,611 total tokens

At the same time, Cloudflare's view of https://moonda.us/api/ai shows 1,079 endpoint requests, with 1,074 attributed to one source IP. Python aiohttp and curl traffic dominate, concentrated around 00:06–00:14 Cambodia time. I have attached the relevant billing-export rows and a short traffic summary.

MOONDA calls DeepSeek server-side, so your logs may show our hosting provider's egress address rather than the original website visitor. The edge records and provider billing cannot be matched one-to-one.

We found that our public proxy lacked adequate usage controls, allowing automated requests to incur charges. We have not established a leaked API key or identified the operator. I have replaced the key, revoked the old key, and deployed server-side rate limits and a shared daily allowance. The site continues to work with the replacement key.

Please preserve relevant per-key request, usage and billing records, confirm the affected usage, and review whether a refund or courtesy account credit is possible. Please also check for related anomalous usage immediately before or after this window and advise whether it warrants a broader review.

Please acknowledge receipt and provide a case reference. No full API key or other credentials are included.

Zhihao Wu
MOONDA operator
